title: Custom Customs
description: Count yes-answers from groups of travellers — anyone vs everyone.
writeup:
## Approach

Each group is a block of lines separated by blank lines. Each person's answers are a set of characters.

## Part 1

For each group, take the **union** of all people's answer sets — any question where *anyone* answered yes. Sum the sizes across all groups.

## Part 2

For each group, take the **intersection** of all people's answer sets — questions where *everyone* answered yes. Sum the sizes across all groups.

Python's `functools.reduce` with `set.union` / `set.intersection` makes this very concise.
